# Axeon Studio
> The one-stop shop for growing Iowa businesses — website, SEO/AEO/GEO, reviews, social media, and lead capture, built and run by one team. Based in West Des Moines, Iowa.

Axeon Studio is a productized web studio and revenue-operations partner. We replace slow, disconnected websites with conversion-built storefronts wired directly into a tailor-made Custom CRM Pipeline — purpose-built intake, lead routing, and follow-up for each client's industry, not a generic template.

**Core differentiators**: Direct partnership (you work with the actual builder, not an account manager), Transparent (published flat-rate pricing instead of custom quotes after multiple discovery calls), and real AI systems tailored to each client's actual lead-to-close workflow — not a generic, templated AI tool with a logo pasted on top.

**Search visibility services**: Every Axeon Studio build includes Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) by default — technical SEO, structured data, and machine-readable content so a business is findable on Google as well as citable by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini. These are not sold as separate add-ons.

## Core Services & Pages
- [Home](https://axeonstudio.co/): High-performance web infrastructure and Custom CRM Pipelines, built and run by one Iowa team.
- [Industries Hub](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions): Purpose-built web + CRM Pipeline solutions for 10 high-ticket local service industries.
- [Dental Practices](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/dental): Same-day emergency triage, insurance verification, and hygiene recall workflows.
- [Med Spas & Aesthetic Clinics](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/med-spa): Treatment-interest intake and membership-retention pipelines.
- [HVAC Companies](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/hvac): Emergency dispatch routing separated from seasonal tune-up bookings.
- [Roofing Contractors](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/roofing): Storm-damage intake with insurance-claim vs. cash-buyer routing.
- [Law Firms](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/law-firms): Practice-area routing and case-evaluation-to-retainer tracking.
- [Accounting & CPA Firms](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/accounting): Tax-prep triage separated from CFO-level advisory leads.
- [Home Remodeling & General Contractors](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/home-remodeling): Budget and scope qualification before the site visit.
- [Real Estate Agents & Teams](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/real-estate): Buyer/seller routing, instant valuation, and showing scheduling.
- [Landscaping Companies](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/landscaping): Recurring maintenance intake separated from one-time hardscape and design bids.
- [Auto Detailing Shops](https://axeonstudio.co/solutions/auto-detailing): Package selection and bay-scheduling built for repeat customers.
- [Marketing Solutions Hub](https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions): The individual services Axeon builds and runs — website, SEO, AI chat, lead generation, video/photography.
- [Website](https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/website): Brand-driven website design and development, not a generic template.
- [SEO, AEO & GEO](https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/seo): Search Engine, Answer Engine, and Generative Engine Optimization, included by default.
- [AI Chat & Online Scheduling](https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/ai-chat-scheduling): A 24/7 AI receptionist that answers, qualifies, and books appointments.
- [Lead Generation](https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/lead-generation): Every lead captured and followed up on automatically in one unified pipeline.
- [Video & Photography](https://axeonstudio.co/marketing-solutions/video-photography): Professional video and photography for your website, ads, and social profiles.
- [Why Axeon](https://axeonstudio.co/why-axeon): Direct comparison of a typical agency vs. Axeon Studio across web design, AI receptionist, data infrastructure, SEO/AEO/GEO, and automation.
- [Pricing](https://axeonstudio.co/pricing): Two flat-rate builds — Core Web Build ($2,800, 7 business days) and Acquisition Engine ($5,800, 14 business days, includes custom on-site videography). No published monthly plan; hosting & care is a separate monthly arrangement quoted on the strategy call, first 30 days included.
- [Des Moines Web Design](https://axeonstudio.co/des-moines-web-design): Local landing page for the Des Moines metro — service area, in-person meetings, on-site video, and industries served.
- [Work](https://axeonstudio.co/work): Concept builds and example layouts showing our approach — Axeon Studio is a new studio still building its client portfolio.
- [Process](https://axeonstudio.co/process): The 7-to-14-day delivery framework used to design, build, and launch every project.
